title: Digikala · A Smile Arrives Home
summary: A new brand promise turns every Digikala delivery into a small moment of joy.
clientDescription: Iran’s leading online marketplace, presented through the launch campaign for its new brand slogan.
challenge: Introduce a new slogan with an image system that feels immediate, human and unmistakably Digikala at city scale.
role: Campaign concept, art direction, key visual development and outdoor adaptation.
deliverables: Campaign key visuals, billboard system, transit lightboxes and BTL activation concept.
credits: Visual concept and campaign art direction by Ali Komeili. Portfolio scenes were newly reconstructed from the original campaign references.

blocks.title: A package becomes a promise.
blocks.text: The new slogan reframes delivery as an emotional arrival. A familiar box, Digikala’s smile and one red balloon turn an ordinary handover into a simple sign of anticipation and delight.

blocks.alt: An Iranian courier delivers the Digikala smile box to a father and daughter at home in Shiraz

blocks.title: One symbol. One human moment.
blocks.text: The system stays deliberately compact: a kraft box, the familiar smile and one red balloon. Keeping the visual language this restrained gives real Iranian faces the space to carry the emotion.

alts: A Digikala smile box floating beneath a red balloon over Shiraz
Iranian woman holding a Digikala smile box beneath a red balloon in Shiraz

blocks.title: One message, carried through the city.
blocks.text: For the Shiraz launch, the photographic scene remains continuous. The rounded red lockup sits over the image as one controlled unit, keeping the slogan, separator and Digikala signature aligned without cutting the key visual into artificial panels.

blocks.alt: Digikala A Smile Arrives Home campaign on a large billboard in Shiraz at dusk

blocks.title: From road speed to a closer encounter.
blocks.text: The same hierarchy adapts to transit scale. At the shelter, backlighting brings the red balloon forward while reflections, fluorescent bands and the wet street make the placement feel present in Shiraz rather than pasted onto it.

blocks.alt: Backlit Digikala campaign lightbox with glass reflections at a bus shelter in Shiraz

blocks.title: The symbol steps into Shiraz.
blocks.text: The campaign extends beyond media placements as a series of physical encounters at the Arg of Karim Khan, the Vakil precinct and the Hafez memorial. Oversized Digikala boxes, each tethered to a single red balloon, become simple urban markers that invite pedestrians to stop, look and photograph the idea.

alts: Digikala box and red balloon BTL installation with pedestrians at the Arg of Karim Khan
A series of Digikala box and balloon installations near the Hafez memorial in Shiraz

blocks.title: Designed for recognition at walking speed.
blocks.text: Each installation keeps the same visual grammar as the campaign: one box, one smile and one balloon. The city supplies the context, while the object stays clear enough to recognise from a distance and approachable enough to encounter up close.

blocks.title: More than a delivery.
blocks.text: Every order carries a product. The campaign gives it one more thing to carry: the feeling that a smile is already on its way home.
